verdict.rationale:
Anthropic publishes a dedicated API release-notes changelog (claude-docs-3/4), a versioning policy that specifies what is preserved across versions (claude-docs-47), a model-IDs-and-versions page, and a standing model-deprecations page with advance-notice retirement floors (claude-supp-model-ids, claude-supp-deprecations) — together these give developers a maintained, trackable record of model/API changes.
missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of changelog cadence or completeness, and no evidence of a subscription/notification mechanism (RSS, email) for change alerts.
